data.name: Label3.Text
data.value: Tollmate is a tollgate system that uses the queue data structure to simulate how vehicles are processed in a real-world toll station. By following the first-in-first-out (FIFO) principle, the system ensures that each vehicle is served in the exact order it arrives. This approach reflects actual tollgate operations, where fairness and order are essential or maintaining traffic flow and avoiding congestion. The queue-based design makes the system efficient, easy to manage, and ideal for basic traffic management simulations.
